decisive_items: Step-up in oxygenation from superior vena cava (71%) and inferior vena cava (77%) to right atrium (84%)
response.rationale: The presence of a large defect with left-to-right shunt and step-up in oxygenation is more specific to Atrial Septal Defect than the general finding of Right Bundle-Branch Block

rejected.why: Lack of specificity to the patient's condition beyond a common ECG finding
